about_the_game:
Toy Smash Kaboom！is a unique fusion of desk organization and tower defense battles! Through diverse equipment combinations and creative strategic designs, we aim to deliver exhilarating combat experiences in every match. Pick your favorite toys and set off on an adventure now!

Background Story

When night falls and children drift into sweet slumber, toys awaken from their dormant state to initiate a marvelous adventure called the "Dream Guardians' Battle" on the study desk. In this world, every clash of toys is a continuation of children's imagination and love—the "Kaboom！" You hear is the rhythm of their beating hearts!

Battle Strategy

In Toy Smash Kaboom, victory hinges not only on your choice of toys but also on the art of strategic placement across your desk battlefield! Unleash devastating power by creatively combining toys with unique traits and synergies. The more ingenious your layout, the more unstoppable your forces become—every inch of desk space is a tactical opportunity to dominate your opponent!

Collect & Craft Items

Every toy in Toy Bang Bang comes with unique shapes, prices, and rarities—higher rarity toys often pack a stronger punch! But don’t overlook low-tier gear! By strategically organizing toys on your desk, you can unlock enhanced equipment effects ✨. Purchase, craft legendary toys, and dominate the battlefield!

Dynamic Battlefield Action

Toys can summon units to clash in explosive battles! Victory isn’t just about depleting enemy HP—knock opponents off the desk for instant elimination! Deploy trap toys to ambush foes and reshape the battlefield mid-fight, turning every inch of the desk into a tactical playground!

Choose Your Story Hero

Pick your favorite protagonist to forge your unique battle style!
